messages.subject: R Working group meeting May 18th 6pm Carlson Health Sci Library
parts:
Do you crave structured time to work on your code, seek advice, or offer wisdom? Or all three?
- Join us for an evening meeting for working on & troubleshooting R, no structured presentations.
AND/OR
- Join us in an online working group forum (email me to join)

Let's meet at 6pm next Thursday in a study room at the Carlson Health Science Library. Bring your laptop. I have reserved room 110 - if you need help finding it, you can ask the reserves/circulation desk. Let me know if you're coming - so I know to expect 2 or 20!

This is also a gauge of interested for evening R working group meetings.  If you can't make this one, let me know if you'd be interested in the general idea of an evening meeting.

Email if you are lost - I will check email near the start time of the meeting.
https://www.library.ucdavis.edu/library/carlson-health-sciences/


Meghan
